name: labs/croningp__pylabware
title: Tricontinent C3000 syringe pump (PyLabware)
intro: Tricontinent C3000 syringe pump (PyLabware), adapted from croningp/pylabware. It reads `plunger_position`, `initialized`, `idle` and `connected`; sets `valve_position`; runs `transfer`, `move_plunger`, `move_home`, `set_speed` and 6 more. `transfer`: dispense or withdraw a number of plunger increments. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/croningp__pylabware --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/croningp__pylabware --backend fake --mcp
